latestVersion.changelog:
Video Skill Online — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based video editing with easy upload and MP4 export (up to 1080p).
- No software installation required—describe edits in plain language.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and other common media formats (max 500MB).
- Built-in credit system with anonymous/free starter tokens; automatic session/token management.
- Error handling for common issues (file type, size, authentication, balance).
- Detailed mapping from user intent to editing actions; translation for backend GUI responses.
